ledger.argument: Save B,n,S,C,e. Set q=floor((n+2^62-1)/n)=ceil(2^62/n), x=0, Ecur=1, h=0. Set base-minus-one-record and scanning pointers.
Save x. Set next encoding to 1 and priority to 0 before EOF branch. If x<n, discover the next run; otherwise go to 41616 with sentinel priority 0.
Save next E; set u=2*x-Lcur, v=2*x+Lnext. Compute z=(q*u) XOR (q*v). The arithmetic uses lengths, not encoded values.

Priority p=clz64(z), with z=0 giving 64. Successive OR-shifts spread the highest set bit downwards; complement and SWAR population count count the leading zeros. For nonterminal valid states z is nonzero, hence p<=63.
If h<2, store without reading a prior priority. Otherwise save end pointers and p, set r7=h, enter pop loop.
Decrement r7 to preceding stack index j. Read P[j]. If P[j]<p, stop: insert current at index j+1 (the saved predecrement r1). Otherwise consume E[j]. Index 0 is never compared.
Store p and current E at the same index. Reload n. If x<n advance with saved next run; otherwise go to final branch.
Load left E, decode a=r8 and b=r6, t=a+b. If t<=C and both low bits are zero, go to 39536: deferred concatenation, no data movement. Otherwise prepare sorting/merge.
Derive A=B+24*(x-t), save t, both encodings and j. If left sorted, skip its sort.

Compute left depth 2*floor(log2(a)); outgoing slots fp-4096=depth, fp-4088=0. CALL 42160 at 38336 gets (A,a,S,C,fp). Restore scheduler state. Only an unsorted positive left run reaches this call, so a<=C.
If right unsorted, CALL 42160 at 38864 with (A+24*a,b,S,C,fp), depth 2*floor(log2(b)), predecessor zero. b<=C. Restore state.

Empty-run and capacity skip edges converge to sorted result. For real merges both encodings>=2, so empty skips are unreachable. min(a,b)<=floor((a+b)/2)<=floor(n/2)<=C, so capacity skip is also unreachable under P0/P1.
Copy exactly 24*min(a,b) bytes to S via 39072. If b<a copy right [A+24*a,A+24*(a+b)); else copy left [A,A+24*a). Select backward or forward merge respectively.
One-ended merges described below. Finish by restoring x,p,j,t; no next-run records are touched.
Encode merged run 2*t+1. If j>1 continue popping from j-1; otherwise store at index 1. Sorted union follows P3/P4 and the one-ended merge argument.
Encode 2*t without sorting only if both runs were deferred and t<=C. Preserves deferred-length invariant. Join the common pop/store continuation.
Load saved next encoding, advance x by its decoded length, set h=stored_index+1 and current=next. Because next covered [old_x,old_x+k), prefix coverage extends exactly to new x.
Test current low bit. Sorted exits at 42152; deferred continues to whole-input sort. EOF collapse proves current represents [0,n), as below.
Compute depth 2*floor(log2(n)), predecessor zero; CALL 42160 at 42144 gets (B,n,S,C,fp), then return. Deferred-length invariant implies n<=C.

imports: P0 valid slice, count bound, nonaliasing, ABI
P1 allocation and exact caller capacity
P3 CALL 42160 recursive and small-sort contracts UNPROVEN HERE
P5 run discovery and window436 sizing contract
conclusions: encoded lengths partition the processed prefix; next run is separate
deferred lengths <= C; all recursive calls fit C
inline merge copies min(a,b) records <= C
real priorities strictly increasing in 0..63; max written index 64; transient count 65
EOF priority zero flushes all real runs; final encoding represents n records
